assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Diagnosis code I25.10 (atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary artery)
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is CPT 93229
The service was denied with CO-50
The denial was on the grounds that the clinical criteria for this diagnostic modality were not met
The criteria for this diagnostic modality were met because it directly correlates the patient's intermittent palpitations with arrhythmias in the setting of coronary artery disease
We request reconsideration of the CO-50 determination
